running.name: HyperQwen B: DFlash2, 64k
running.cmd: podman run --rm --name hyperqwen-b --network host --device nvidia.com/gpu=all -v /models/hq:/models:ro -e SPEC=dflash2 -e CTX=fast -e DFLASH_TOKENS=15 -e PREFIX_CACHE=1 -e MODEL=/models/hq-uncensored -e PORT=5830 ghcr.io/example/hyperqwen:2026.09 single

running.name: Flash EXL3 (SGLang)
running.cmd: podman run --name flash --rm --network llama --shm-size 64g --device nvidia.com/gpu=all -v /models/x:/models/x:ro -e HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 -e SGLANG_EXL3_MOE_OFFLOAD=gpu_cache ghcr.io/example/sglang-exl3@sha256:abc python3 -m sglang.launch_server --model-path /models/x --quantization exl3 --host 0.0.0.0 --port 30100 --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 --context-length 204800 --mem-fraction-static 0.88 --max-running-requests 2

running.name: Bonsai on Strata
running.cmd: podman run --rm --name flash-strata --network llama --device nvidia.com/gpu=all -v /models/strata:/data:ro localhost/strata:v0.1.27-sm86 python serve/server.py --engine strata --config /data/strata.json --port 8095

running.name: Invented 30B (llama.cpp image)
running.cmd: podman run --name lcpp-a --rm --network llama --device nvidia.com/gpu=all --security-opt label=disable --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges -v /srv/models:/models:ro ghcr.io/example/llama.cpp@sha256:0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5850 -fa on --metrics -m /models/invented/Invented-30B-A3B-IQ4_XS.gguf --min-p 0 --chat-template-kwargs '{"enable_thinking":true}' -ngl 999 -ncmoe 39 -c 262144 -ctk f16 -ctv f16 -fit off --temp 1.0 --top-p 0.95 --top-k 20 --min-p 0 --reasoning-budget 26000 -lm none
